articles.title: Card replacement service levels
articles.body: Standard card replacement takes 5-7 business days. Expedited replacement, where available, takes 2-3 business days. Identity verification is required before an order is placed.

articles.title: Lost or stolen card response
articles.body: Treat a reported stolen card as a high-risk security event. Prioritize freezing or blocking the card, preserve the customer report, and escalate to the fraud queue for human review. Do not close the case or send a final customer response automatically.

articles.title: Card payment troubleshooting
articles.body: Confirm the card is active, check balance and merchant restrictions, and ask whether other transactions work. Never ask for a PIN, full card number, password, or one-time code.

articles.title: Suspected account takeover
articles.body: Unexpected credential or profile changes require a security hold and mandatory human escalation. Do not reverse changes or disclose account details until identity checks are complete.

articles.title: Complaint handling
articles.body: Acknowledge the issue in plain language, avoid assigning blame, preserve the complaint record, and route repeat service failures to an operator when policy requires.
